dimensions.assessment: Affects members of the Armed Forces working as air traffic controllers, civilian FAA air traffic controllers, and relevant agency personnel.
dimensions.evidence: improve the transition of civilian air traffic control specialists under the jurisdiction of the Secretary of Defense into the Department of Transportation

dimensions.assessment: Focuses on identifying barriers, standardizing credentials, and formulating recommendations rather than executing immediate operational changes.
dimensions.evidence: the working group shall identify any barriers... in training, phraseology, systems, or technology

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending levels or direct appropriations are stated or authorized in the source text.
Amends existing statutory working group duties under the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024 with respect to the activities of the joint aviation employment training working group

dimensions.assessment: Modifies ongoing working group duties and recommendations established under prior law.
dimensions.evidence: Section 425 of the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024 (Public Law 118-63) is amended

missing_information: Estimated number of military air traffic controllers expected to transition under the recommendations.
importance_detail.rationale: Amends the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024 to direct a working group to develop recommendations and identify training or technology barriers for transitioning military air traffic controllers into civilian roles at the FAA.
